summary: Frontend verification of the follow-up fixes: (1) PROFILE message-seller SPA, (2) AUCTION detail message-seller SPA, (3) header notification links SPA, (4) story hold-to-pause + release resume, and (5) regression on auto-advance & close. Message-seller SPA works from BOTH places, story hold-to-pause works exactly as specified (animationPlayState toggles paused<->running, .story-paused-hint shows, no auto-advance while held for 6s+). Notification-dropdown Inertia <Link> is wired correctly (SPA preserved), BUT the per-notification `link` field is EMPTY on all 4 seeded notifications, so clicks resolve to href='' (current URL) — the SPA plumbing works but there is no destination to navigate to. Story close after auto-advance to next user occasionally fails to dismiss on first click (already noted in iteration_6).

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered as <a href=""> because n.link is empty for all seeded notifications. Inertia <Link> conversion is done correctly (window.__spa='alive' is preserved on click, no full reload), but clicking any of the 4 unread notification items keeps user on the same page (href='' resolves to current URL). Root cause is DATA/backend supplying empty `link` field on NotificationResource. Frontend is technically correct.
data-testid=story-close click sometimes does not close the viewer after auto-advance from user A -> user B (still occurs; same as iteration_6). Non-blocking; direct close on same-user story works.

verified_features.test3_notification_spa_mechanism: PASS (mechanism) / FAIL (destination) — Click on a.dropdown-item keeps __spa='alive' (Inertia <Link> intercepted click, no full reload) BUT n.link=='' so page didn't change. Item outerHTML confirms href='' on all 4 unread items.
verified_features.test4_story_hold_to_pause: PASS — Before hold: playState='running', animation='5s linear forwards storyFill'. During pointerdown on #svMedia (2s): playState='paused', .story-paused-hint visible (display:flex, opacity:1). Continued hold ~6s: still paused, same story (no auto-advance while held). After pointerup: playState='running' resumed. Screenshot .screenshots/story_hold_paused.png shows pause indicator (‖) overlay on the media.
verified_features.test5_auto_advance: PASS — With no hold, img.src changed after ~5s (progress bar completed animation → next story).
verified_features.test5_story_close: MOSTLY FAIL in same session — After long test session (post auto-advance to next user), single click on data-testid=story-close did not dismiss #svMedia. Same intermittent bug from iteration_6.

action_items: Fix backend NotificationResource to populate `link` field (target URL like /messages/{id} or /support/tickets/{id}) so header notification items actually navigate somewhere. Frontend SPA conversion is already correct.
Investigate story-close reliability after cross-user auto-advance transition (may be a race between resetting viewer state and click handler).
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.vue L234: <Link :href="n.link"> — no fallback when n.link is empty; consider `:href="n.link || route('notifications.index')"` so clicks always land somewhere sensible.
Console shows repeated 403s on /api/notifications/... polling — already reported and expected per this request.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 core assertions PASS (profile msg SPA, auction msg SPA, story hold-pause, hold-no-advance, release-resume, auto-advance). Notification SPA mechanism works but destination href is empty; story-close post-auto-advance intermittent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The key finding: notification <Link> click DOES preserve __spa (SPA works), but n.link is empty in payload — backend/data-side fix needed on NotificationResource.link. Story hold-to-pause uses pointerdown/pointerup on #svMedia; dispatching PointerEvent + MouseEvent in evaluate() works reliably. .story-paused-hint element is always present in DOM; only display/opacity change between paused/running — do NOT assert on element existence, assert on getComputedStyle(hint).display or animationPlayState.
rca of the issue: Notification dropdown non-navigation: <Link :href="n.link"> resolves to href='' because the NotificationResource returns empty string for `link`. Fix by populating a proper URL server-side (or add frontend fallback to route('notifications.index')).
